name: Collective Brutality
oracle_text:
Escalate—Discard a card. (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
Choose one or more —
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card.
• Target creature gets -2/-2 until end of turn.
• Target opponent loses 2 life and you gain 2 life.
blocked_sentences: Escalate—Discard a card. (Pay this cost for each mode chosen beyond the first.)
• Target opponent reveals their hand. You choose an instant or sorcery card from it. That player discards that card.

needs.what: card-level `escalate` accepting a non-mana cost (here a full Cost spec such as {"discard": 1}), charged once per mode chosen beyond the first, with the same mode-count tie that mana escalate has (casting._additional_ceiling and Game._cast's `exactly`); the discarded card must not be the spell itself (601.2a)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The loader parses `escalate` with ManaCost.parse and desugars it to CostModel(mana=...), and rejects a free (mana value 0) escalate, so "Discard a card" cannot be written there. Hand-desugaring to additional_cost {discard: 1} + additional_optional + additional_repeatable is multikicker's shape: the loader refuses escalate beside another additional cost, and without the `escalate` flag nothing ties the number of discards to the number of modes, so a plain `or_more` choose_mode would take every mode for one or zero discards. `spree` prices each mode individually including the first.

needs.what: a discard in which the target player reveals their hand and the spell's controller (not the discarding player) chooses a card matching a filter (here an instant or sorcery card) to be discarded -- Duress's shape; no discard if none matches
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `discard` takes only amount, as, player, random, up_to and whole_hand: the discarding player always chooses (or it is random), and there is no filter on which card may be taken. `reveal` and `look_at_hand` show the hand but cannot hand the choice to the caster or restrict it to instants and sorceries.
